outcome: vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 to neonates
cohort: Pregnant women who exhibited symptoms or had a suspicion of exposure to confirmed COVID-19 were recruited from Zainab Panjwani Memorial Hospital, Karachi.
finding: The study found a low risk of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 from mother to neonate, with the viral genome showing similar mutations in the infected mother and the neonate.
gest_age: Participants were included regardless of gestational age, with delivery occurring at a mean of 38.3 weeks in the positive and recovered case groups.
